response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and some high-performance systems work (low-latency D services at Sociomantic handling millions of requests/second). However, the core requirement — modern C++ or Rust in commercial/open-source settings — is barely met: his C/C++ work is a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis, and there is no Rust at all. The last decade has been predominantly TypeScript/Node.js/D full-stack and product work, with no experience in routing pipelines, tiling, navigation guidance, or large-scale distributed data infrastructure. He could plausibly ramp up given his systems mindset and D experience (which transfers reasonably to C++), but he would start well behind candidates with current C++ and navigation-domain depth.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map
Low-latency, high-throughput backend work in D (Sociomantic), plus Linux/DevOps depth
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source contributions
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and over a decade stale; no Rust
No routing/tiling, map data pipeline, or navigation guidance experience
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack TypeScript, not systems engineering
